claim.claim-text: 1. A method (1400) for a User Equipment-to-User Equipment, in the following also referred to as UE-to-UE, Relay to perform a link identifier update procedure, comprising:

the UE-to-UE Relay receives a first PC5-S message from a first UE to modify at least one link identifier of the first UE, wherein the first PC5-S message is transmitted by using an old Layer-2 Identity, in the following also referred to as ID, of the first UE as a source Layer-2 ID of the first PC5-S message, and wherein the first PC5-S message includes a new Layer-2 ID of the first UE and a new Application Layer ID of the first UE (1405); and in response to reception of the first PC5-S message, the UE-to-UE Relay transmits a second PC5-S message to a second UE to modify the at least one link identifier of the first UE (1410), wherein the second PC5-S message is transmitted by using an old Layer-2 ID of the UE-to-UE Relay as a source Layer-2 ID of the second PCS-S message, and wherein the second PC5-S message includes the new Application Layer ID of the first UE, characterized in that the second PC5-S message does not include the new Layer-2 ID of the first UE.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the first UE and the second UE communicate with each other via the UE-to-UE Relay.
3. The method of claim 1 or 2, wherein the at least one link identifier of the first UE is used for a first PC5 unicast link established between the UE-to-UE Relay and the first UE.
4. The method of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the second PC5-S message further includes a new Layer-2 ID of the UE-to-UE Relay.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the new Layer-2 ID of the UE-to-UE Relay is used for a second PC5 unicast link established between the UE-to-UE Relay and the second UE.
6. The method of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the first PC5-S message includes a new Internet Protocol, in the following also referred to as IP, address of the first UE.
7. The method of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the second PC5-S message includes the new IP address of the first UE.
8. A User Equipment-to-User Equipment, in the following also referred to as UE-to-UE, Relay, comprising:
